steps.title: 導線複合：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「導線複合」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for composite conductor.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「導線複合」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。鋼芯與導體層共同承擔拉力和熱伸長。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較各材料面積與應變相容。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for composite conductor, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Core and conductor layers share tension and thermal expansion. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare areas and strain compatibility. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較各材料面積與應變相容。
steps.observationEn: Compare areas and strain compatibility.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「導線複合」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping composite conductor verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「導線複合」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「比較各材料面積與應變相容。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for composite conductor; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制

knowledge.textEn: Core and conductor layers share tension and thermal expansion.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較各材料面積與應變相容。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 小弧垂拋物線假設：均布重量 w=15 N/m、跨距 L=300 m、水平張力 H=30 kN，弧垂 f=wL²/(8H)=5.625 m。風、覆冰及高差未納入，不能用於現場淨空放行。

quiz.question: 審查「導線複合」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for composite conductor?
options: 鋼芯與導體層共同承擔拉力和熱伸長。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「導線複合」的驗證。
只調整「導線複合」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Core and conductor layers share tension and thermal expansion.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping composite conductor verification.
Tuning the displayed composite conductor result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.

summary: 以弧垂、風冰載荷與動態熱額定串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect sag, wind/ice loads and dynamic thermal ratings through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.
